description: One flap drive's powertrain: the MAD M13 EEE KV90 motor (motor 9 in the blade element theory code), an ODrive Pro motor controller, a gearbox, and the controller's feedback gains. The measured points are the ones the blade element theory motor limit simulation fits its torque-speed and torque-current lines to. The first measured current is the no-load current, 2 * 48 / 20 A.

feedback_gains.description: Gains on the motor's position error (N*m/rad) and velocity error (N*m*s/rad), added to the feedforward torque.
